## Function Approximation

```{julia}
using Plots, Measures, LaTeXStrings


g(x) = cos(2cos(x^2) + (1/4)*(x - 1)^2) + x/2 + 1
low = 0; high = 4;

function make_uv(r)
    δ = (high - low)/(r - 1)
    u = low:δ:high
    v = g.(u);
    u, v
end

function make_f(u, v)
    r = length(u)
    σ(x) = max(x, 0)
    N0 = 1
    N1 = r - 1
    N2 = 1;
    W1 = ones(N1, 1)
    b1 = -[u[i] for i in 1:N1];
    s(i) = (i == 0 ? 0 : (v[i + 1] - v[i])/(u[i + 1] - u[i]))
    W2 = hcat([s(i) - s(i - 1) for i in 1:N1]...)
    b2 = v[1]
    f(x) = (W2*σ.(W1*x + b1) .+ b2)[1, 1]
    return f
end


f25 = make_f(make_uv(25)...)
```

```{julia}
xgrid = low:0.005:high

u, v = make_uv(10)
f25 = make_f(u, v)
p1 = plot(xgrid, g.(xgrid), label = L"f^*(x)", lw = 2)
     plot!(xgrid, f25.(xgrid), label = L"f(x ; r = 10)", lw = 2)
     scatter!(u, v, label = L"(u_1, v_1), \ldots, (u_{10}, v_{10})")

u, v = make_uv(30)
f50 = make_f(u, v)
p2 = plot(xgrid, g.(xgrid), label = L"f^*(x)", lw = 2)
     plot!(xgrid, f50.(xgrid), label = L"f(x ; r = 30)", lw = 2)
     scatter!(u, v, label = L"(u_1, v_1), \ldots, (u_{30}, v_{30})")

plot(p1, p2, size = (800, 400), margin = 10mm, xlabel = "Input x", ylabel = "Output", legend = :topleft, ylim=(0, 5))

```

```{julia}
plot(p1, size = (400, 400), xlabel = "Input x", ylabel = "Output", legend = :topleft, ylim = (0, 5))
```

# Loss Functions

```{julia}
using Distributions

sq_err(x) = x^2
abs_err(x) = abs(x)
hub_err(x) = abs(x) < 1 ? x^2/2 : abs(x) - 1/2


x_grid = -2:0.005:2
p1 = plot(x_grid, sq_err.(x_grid), label = "Squared loss", legend = :topleft, xlabel = L"\hat{y}^{(i)} - y^{(i)}", ylabel = "Loss", legendfont = font(12))
plot!(x_grid, abs_err.(x_grid), label = "Absolute loss", lw = 2)
plot!(x_grid, hub_err.(x_grid), label = "Huber loss", lw = 2)

```
```{julia}
savefig("error_functions.pdf")
```

```{julia}

plot!(x_grid, pdf(Laplace(), x_grid), label = "Laplace Distribution", lw = 2)
```
